title: 9 Signs a Godly Man Is Winning the War Against His Phone
caption:
His grandfather never fought this battle. You fight it every day, in your pocket. Save this and be honest about which ones are still true for you and which ones you're actually winning. Then send one to a brother, the line that names exactly where you're at, and let him hold you to it this week.

Winning this fight was never about deleting the phone. It's about who's actually running your attention.
